design_direction: Distinct pincer, crystal framework, armored angular, and asymmetric stinger silhouettes. Original concepts retained.

assets.name: 余烬·天蝎
assets.detail: Concept 'PINCER SIEGE BOW'. Crimson and ruby red, restrained rose highlights. A SHORT, WIDE, muscular war bow, substantially wider across the limb than a conventional longbow. Each limb consists of TWO massive triangular armor blades nested as an OPEN ANGULAR PINCER with a large square-ish bite cut from the inner edge, attached at one sturdy elbow; the pinching blade tips aim diagonally outward away from hand. Three large planes per limb, clear thick chamfers, imposing axe-blade-like mass but unmistakable bow silhouette. The main upper and lower limbs are mostly straight oblique beams with one hard recurve, no flowing arcs. An angular solid bridge joins both limbs to a short straight hexagonal handgrip. A broad trapezoid knuckle guard on OUTER side of grip protects the hand; open arrow path toward string. Short chisel-shaped string tips. Sparse red triangular chips and small chunky ember particles. Powerful compact red siege weapon, not delicate or elegant.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original Scorpio zodiac fantasy BOW concept for a Skyrim geometric magical-light weapon collection. ONE weapon per image, portrait 2:3, pure black background, full upright bow including both tips with generous margins. Slight three-quarter orthographic side view, structural thickness visible and silhouette readable. One thin straight taut luminous bowstring on RIGHT joining upper and lower limb endpoints. Central physically graspable handle and clear space behind handle for drawing arrow; bow geometry must connect from handle to both tips, no detached structural pieces. Materials: solid saturated colored magical geometry, broad dark translucent-light faces and clear narrow glowing bevels, restrained bloom, crisp edges, no overexposure. A FEW small local particles indicate proposed draw effects without hiding structure. Premium bold game weapon concept art. No person, arrow, lettering, symbols, labels, panels, numbers, watermark, metal engraving, wood, leather or mundane machinery. Crucial art direction: a radical silhouette redesign departing from elegant flowing bows. NO smooth S-shaped limbs, NO two flowing braided ribbons, NO moon-shaped finials, NO generic leaf fins, NO teardrop cutouts, NO six-pointed star. Angular, substantial geometric forms, not thin line drawings, no repetitive tiny jewelry. Scorpio theme is ABSTRACT armored plates/pincers/stinger, no literal animal or scorpion figurine.

assets.name: 流萤·天蝎
assets.detail: Concept 'VENOM CRYSTAL TRUSS'. Emerald green with luminous lime-green edge accents and small teal crystal depths. A tall open-framework GEOMETRIC LONGBOW constructed of FOUR large hollow elongated RHOMBUS CELLS along each limb, alternating diagonal orientations with thick STRAIGHT prism rails and widely spaced triangular braces. The cells progressively taper and articulate into a polygonal bow curve; a small solid faceted emerald wedge nests in only TWO of the cells, leaving others empty. Four large cells, NOT dozens of tiny beads. Central grip is a narrow vertical rectangular bar offset inside a broad angular open diamond riser, hand passage clear, no star or ring. String tips are precise straight spearhead wedges with short lateral notches. All diamond-cell corners touch and join, continuous physical structure. A FEW sharp green kite-shaped chips and tiny mint hexagon particles close to the cell openings. Airy architectural skeletal frame, entirely distinct from plated or ribbon bows.

assets.name: 寒汐·天蝎
assets.detail: Concept 'GLACIAL BASTION BOW'. Deep sapphire blue with cyan edge lines. A heavy broad-bodied bow with a SQUARED C silhouette, two long near-vertical FLAT SLAB limbs joined to the central grasp by sharply offset right-angle shoulders, stepped rectangular negative spaces and two massive diagonal elbows. The limb body resembles precisely cut interlocking polygonal stone/energy armor, only THREE huge plates on each half, broad clean surfaces, recessed grooves following straight lines, not literal stone texture. Each large plate has a clipped corner and thick bevels; the outside is a staircase outline rather than a curve. A stout octagonal handgrip sits in a clean narrow central waist, the upper and lower shoulders are large L-shaped gussets with one rectangular aperture each. Both string endpoints have blunt short angled wedge tips, NO ornamental spikes. Sparse tiny cyan hollow squares and short blue dash particles. Monumental minimalist angular structure, visually heavy, NOT a crossbow, firearm, mechanical compound bow, crescent or truss.

assets.name: 梦隙·天蝎
assets.detail: Concept 'STINGER SPINE'. Indigo violet and amethyst purple with pale lavender luminous joints. A deliberately ASYMMETRIC very tall bow: the upper limb is 1.55 times as long as the lower limb, both still connect via a usable handle and one single straight string. Upper limb is an articulated polygonal chain of FIVE large elongated tapered solid prisms, swept back at hard obtuse angles, like an abstract scorpion tail; the uppermost segment ends in ONE exceptionally long narrow straight needle spike that aims diagonally toward string side. Segments are joined by compact visible triangular hinges made of solid purple light, no floating pieces. Lower limb is only THREE broader shorter plates with a single blunt hooked angular string seat acting as visual counterweight. Outer edge has bold negative gaps between stepped plate faces while a strong spine physically connects everything. Grip is a slim oblique tapered prism with a short asymmetric triangular guard on the outer side and a tiny inset purple crystal, no diamond cage, loop or circle. Sparse tiny lavender needle shards and angular zigzag particles close to upper joints. Predatory unconventional asymmetry, jagged deliberate straight-line silhouette, NO curving ribbons or smooth arcs.
